summary: Choose Git worktrees when starting agents from stui or the phone, and show their requested branch.

replay.detail: No additional replay or recovery trigger. Checkout metadata is read from existing agent declarations while serving projections; this change introduces no stored claim kind.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema-version change. The additive client resource JSON fields are classified under compatibility.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, digest or rules-version change, and no coordinated member-upgrade requirement added.

compatibility.detail: Agent resources add optional workspace and checkout repository/base/branch fields to Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients. Older daemons omit them and older clients can ignore them. Worktree launch requires a daemon supporting agent.create checkout parameters and host.repositories, introduced in #1237; upgrade that daemon before using these forms. Missing suggestions are shown as an error and a repository path can be typed. Current client fixtures cover present and absent metadata, and typed creation/projection and real Git worktree regressions pass. No pairing-scope or harness protocol change. Real mixed-build pairs and the physical-phone trial have not been exercised for this change.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond an ordinary daemon/client update. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health durations were not measured for this change.

manual.detail: Existing declarations, workspaces and identities need no migration. Update the daemon and clients normally to expose the optional form fields; existing plain-directory launches remain available.

recovery.detail: No additional database recovery or migration reversal. Swapping back the clients removes these form choices and labels; agent checkout declarations retain the daemon behavior already introduced in #1237.
